mission.paragraph_1: The Paediatric Interest Group (PIG) is a student-led organisation dedicated to fostering interest and excellence in paediatric medicine among medical students. We bridge the gap between theoretical knowledge and clinical practice through hands-on training, educational workshops, and community outreach focused on child health.
mission.paragraph_2: PIG equips students with essential clinical skills, promotes patient-centred paediatric care, and creates opportunities for leadership, mentorship, and professional development; preparing students for clinical clerkships while making a meaningful impact in the community.

upcoming_events.description:
Starting junior clerkship soon? 
Join us for an interactive seminar designed to help you confidently navigate the childhood immunization schedule and apply it in a clinical setting.

upcoming_events.title: Vital Signs Workshop
upcoming_events.description:
Think you know your vital signs? Paediatrics changes the rules! 

Join us for an interactive workshop where you’ll learn how to measure and interpret key vital signs, understand how normal ranges change with age, and recognize when a reading should raise concern.
